findings.evidence: The row describes each model as running 'in its own CLI agent harness' and notes 'each model runs under its own harness selection', but the published protocol states a single uniform harness: SOURCE 2 blog: 'We evaluate each model at its maximum reasoning effort, with Proximus as the default harness and a 20-hour budget per task'; SOURCE 5 README: 'We evaluated all models using our harness Proximus'. The row's own version_guard says 'uniform harness proximus', making the description internally contradictory.
findings.repair: Change the description to say models are evaluated with the Proximus harness (e.g. 'using the Proximus harness'), and remove or correct the 'its own harness selection' / 'other harnesses' statements in scoring.notes.

findings.evidence: The notes claim the Epoch relay CSV 'restates 12 overlapping rows', but SOURCE 6 (the supplied relay CSV) contains 13 data rows after the header, each with Source https://www.frontierswe.com/ (claude-fable-5-1, gpt-5.6-sol, glm-5.3, kimi-k3, grok-4.6, gemini-3.7-flash, qwen3.8-max, muse-spark-1.2, Inkling, gpt-6-astra, claude-opus-5, claude-fable-5, gemini-3.8-flash).
findings.repair: Correct the count to 13 overlapping rows or remove the unspecified count.

findings.evidence: The notes state 'proximus is uniform across the main board’s 14 rows' and that 'the site additionally shows an Other Harnesses view', but the captured main page (SOURCE 1) shows a leaderboard numbered 1 through 10 (GPT-6 Astra … Inkling) and contains no 'Other Harnesses' view. The bounded excerpt does not support a 14-row count or the existence of that additional view.
findings.repair: Remove the unverifiable '14 rows' count and the 'Other Harnesses view' claim, or provide a primary source excerpt supporting them.
